sentences.en: During the vacation, I read the entire works of Milton.
sentences.zh: 假期里，我读完了弥尔顿的所有作品。

sentences.en: Working together, they cleaned the entire house in no time.
sentences.zh: 合作之下，他们很快就把整个房子打扫干净了。

sentences.en: A network of railroads soon spread over the entire country.
sentences.zh: 铁路网很快就覆盖了全国的每一个角落。
